text: Preserve supervisor authority audit through backend runtime-state updates
description: Fix the backend watchdog runtime-state schema and merge path, which currently strip supervisorState—and therefore the authority audit—from valid session-written snapshots. Define a focused Zod schema for payload-free authority entries and supervisor state, retain only the newest 50 audit entries, preserve supervisorState when updateWatchdogRuntimeState changes enabled/emergency/stop fields, and add deterministic schema/merge tests proving valid audit continuity and unknown payload stripping. Do not start or restart backend services.

reflections.context: Inspection showed the backend runtime schema omitted supervisorState entirely, and updateWatchdogRuntimeState reconstructed agent state from four control fields. Any backend read/update could therefore strip the state engine metadata and new authority audit written by sessions.
reflections.outcome: Extracted focused watchdog runtime Zod schemas, including payload-free bounded authority entries and supervisor state. Added a pure control-state merge that preserves supervisorState, switched the project router to it, strips unknown audit fields, and retains the newest 50 entries.
reflections.effectiveness: Backend focused tests 2/2 and full suite 70/70 pass; backend TypeScript build passes. Wrapped-agents/common remains green at 161/161 with tsc --noEmit, and git diff --check passes. No backend or development server was started or restarted.
reflections.lesson: Cross-component persistence contracts fail when each boundary owns an incomplete ad hoc schema. Unrelated partial updates must merge through a tested function that explicitly preserves opaque higher-level state.
reflections.pattern: Extract shared-within-service persistence schemas and pure merge functions; test both field continuity and payload stripping at the component that rewrites the file.

supportingConnections.explanation: Consumes the authority audit now preserved through backend runtime state.

status.comment: Backend runtime schema and merge now preserve bounded supervisor authority audits; internally verified and awaiting explicit user acceptance.

valueRationale: Safety evidence must not be silently erased by an unrelated control-state update at another runtime boundary.
